claim: Each metric data point must be associated with a time stamp, which can be up to two weeks in the past and up to two hours into the future; if you do not provide a time stamp, CloudWatch creates one based on the time the data point was received.

evidence.quote: Each metric data point must be associated with a time stamp. The time stamp can be up to two weeks in the past and up to two hours into the future. If you do not provide a time stamp, CloudWatch creates a time stamp for you based on the time the data point was received.
